name: projects/msklad-bi-prod/locations/asia-east1/workflows/msklad-pipeline-hourly
sourceContents:
main:
  params: [args]
  steps:
    - init:
        assign:
          - run_id: ${sys.now()}
          - cf_dim:       "https://cf-dim-xw5u2boozq-de.a.run.app"
          - cf_fx:        "https://cf-fx-xw5u2boozq-de.a.run.app"
          - cf_facts:     "https://cf-facts-xw5u2boozq-de.a.run.app"
          - cf_dq:        "https://cf-dq-xw5u2boozq-de.a.run.app"
    - step_dim:
        try:
          call: http.post
          args:
            url: ${cf_dim}
            auth:
              type: OIDC
            body:
              run_id: ${run_id}
            timeout: 540
          result: dim_result
        except:
          as: e
          steps:
            - log_dim_error:
                call: sys.log
                args:
                  text: ${"[HOURLY] step_dim FAILED run_id=" + run_id + " error=" + json.encode_to_string(e)}
                  severity: ERROR
            - raise_dim:
                raise: ${e}
    - step_fx:
        try:
          call: http.post
          args:
            url: ${cf_fx}
            auth:
              type: OIDC
            body:
              run_id: ${run_id}
            timeout: 180
          result: fx_result
        except:
          as: e
          steps:
            - log_fx_error:
                call: sys.log
                args:
                  text: ${"[HOURLY] step_fx FAILED run_id=" + run_id + " error=" + json.encode_to_string(e)}
                  severity: ERROR
            - raise_fx:
                raise: ${e}
    - step_facts:
        try:
          call: http.post
          args:
            url: ${cf_facts}
            auth:
              type: OIDC
            body:
              run_id: ${run_id}
              mode: "hourly"
            timeout: 600
          result: facts_result
        except:
          as: e
          steps:
            - log_facts_error:
                call: sys.log
                args:
                  text: ${"[HOURLY] step_facts FAILED run_id=" + run_id + " error=" + json.encode_to_string(e)}
                  severity: ERROR
            - raise_facts:
                raise: ${e}
    - step_dq:
        try:
          call: http.post
          args:
            url: ${cf_dq}
            auth:
              type: OIDC
            body:
              run_id: ${run_id}
            timeout: 120
          result: dq_result
        except:
          as: e
          steps:
            - log_dq_error:
                call: sys.log
                args:
                  text: ${"[HOURLY] step_dq CRASHED run_id=" + run_id + " error=" + json.encode_to_string(e)}
                  severity: CRITICAL
            - raise_dq:
                raise: ${e}
    - parse_dq_result:
        assign:
          - dq_parsed: ${json.decode(dq_result.body)}
    - check_dq:
        switch:
          - condition: ${not(dq_parsed.passed)}
            steps:
              - log_dq_failed:
                  call: sys.log
                  args:
                    text: ${"[HOURLY] DQ Gate FAILED run_id=" + run_id + " details=" + json.encode_to_string(dq_parsed)}
                    severity: CRITICAL
              - raise_dq_failed:
                  raise: "DQ Gate failed — promote blocked"
    - step_promote:
        try:
          call: http.post
          args:
            url: ${cf_facts}
            auth:
              type: OIDC
            body:
              run_id: ${run_id}
              mode: "promote"
              window_days: 7
            timeout: 300
          result: promote_result
        except:
          as: e
          steps:
            - log_promote_error:
                call: sys.log
                args:
                  text: ${"[HOURLY] step_promote FAILED run_id=" + run_id + " error=" + json.encode_to_string(e)}
                  severity: ERROR
            - raise_promote:
                raise: ${e}
    - step_purchases:
        try:
          call: http.post
          args:
            url: ${cf_facts}
            auth:
              type: OIDC
            body:
              run_id: ${run_id}
              mode: "purchases"
              window_days: 90
            timeout: 300
          result: purchases_result
        except:
          as: e
          steps:
            - log_purchases_warning:
                call: sys.log
                args:
                  text: ${"[HOURLY] step_purchases FAILED (non-blocking) run_id=" + run_id + " error=" + json.encode_to_string(e)}
                  severity: WARNING
    - done:
        steps:
          - log_success:
              call: sys.log
              args:
                text: ${"[HOURLY] Pipeline COMPLETED run_id=" + run_id}
                severity: INFO
          - return_result:
              return: ${promote_result.body}
